By doing so, we save costs and reduce the environmental impact of our Annual Meeting. On October&#160;22, 2026, we mailed a Notice of Internet Availability of Proxy Materials to certain of our shareholders. The Notice contains instructions about how to access our proxy materials and vote online or by telephone. If you would like to receive a paper copy of our proxy materials, please follow the instructions included in the Notice of Internet Availability of Proxy Materials. If you previously chose to receive our proxy materials electronically, you will continue to receive access to these materials via email unless you elect otherwise. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p><div style="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0075c9">&#160;</div> <p style="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:Arial" id="toc61756_45"><span style="color:#0075c9"><span style="font-weight:bold">Participating in the Annual Meeting </span></span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">This year&#8217;s virtual<span style="font-weight:bold"> </span>Annual Meeting will be conducted at <span style="text-decoration:underline">virtualshareholdermeeting.com/MSFT26</span> on December&#160;8, 2026 at 8:30 a.m.<span style="text-decoration:underline"> </span>Pacific Time. You are entitled to participate in the Annual Meeting if you were a shareholder as of the close of business on September&#160;30, 2026, the record date, or hold a valid proxy for the meeting. To be admitted to the Annual Meeting, you must enter the <span style="white-space:nowrap">16-digit</span> Control Number found next to the label &#8220;Control Number&#8221; on your Notice of Internet Availability, proxy card, or voting instruction form, or in the email sending you the Proxy Statement. If you are a beneficial shareholder, you may contact the bank, broker, or other institution where you hold your account if you have questions about obtaining your Control Number. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">The meeting will be followed by a question and answer session. Questions may be submitted in advance of the meeting beginning on October&#160;22, 2026 at <span style="text-decoration:underline">proxyvote.com</span> after logging in with your Control Number, or during the Annual Meeting through <span style="text-decoration:underline">virtualshareholdermeeting.com/MSFT26</span>. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">We recommend that you access the Annual Meeting before it begins. Online <span style="white-space:nowrap">check-in</span> opens approximately thirty minutes before the start of the meeting. If you have difficulty accessing the meeting, please call <span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="white-space:nowrap">1-844-986-0822</span></span></span> (toll free) or <span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="white-space:nowrap">303-562-9302</span></span> (international). We will have technicians available to assist you. </p> <p style="font-size:24pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p><div style="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0075c9">&#160;</div> <p style="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:Arial" id="toc61756_46"><span style="color:#0075c9"><span style="font-weight:bold">Soliciting Proxies </span></span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">The Board of Directors is soliciting the proxy accompanying this Proxy Statement. Proxies may be solicited by officers, directors, and employees of Microsoft, none of whom will receive any additional compensation for their services. D.F. King&#160;&amp; Co., Inc. may solicit proxies at a cost we anticipate will not exceed $20,000. These solicitations may be made personally or by mail, telephone, messenger, email, or other electronic transmission. If you are a registered shareholder and would like to either participate in householding or receive separate copies of this year&#8217;s and/or future proxy materials, please contact our transfer agent, Computershare, by mail at P.O. Box 43006, Providence, RI, 02940-3078; by phone at <span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="white-space:nowrap">800-285-7772,</span></span> option&#160;1; or by email at <span style="text-decoration:underline">web.queries@computershare.com</span>. If you are a beneficial shareholder, you may contact the broker or bank where you hold the account. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p><div style="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0075c9">&#160;</div> <p style="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:Arial" id="toc61756_48"><span style="color:#0075c9"><span style="font-weight:bold">Election of Directors </span></span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">Twelve directors are to be elected during the Annual Meeting to hold office until the next annual meeting and until their respective successors are elected and qualified. If, for any reason, no directors are elected at an annual meeting, a slate of directors may be elected at a special meeting of shareholders called for that purpose in the manner provided by our Bylaws. The accompanying proxy will be voted in favor of the nominees presented in Part 1 &#8211; Board of Directors and Governance to serve as directors unless the shareholder indicates to the contrary on the proxy. All of this year&#8217;s nominees are current directors, except Mr.&#160;Collison. The Board expects that each of the nominees will be available for election, but if any of them is unable to serve at the time the election occurs, the proxy will be voted for the election of another nominee designated by our Board. A nominee who does not receive a majority of the votes cast will not be elected. Except as explained in the next paragraph, an incumbent director who is not elected because he or she does not receive a majority vote will continue to serve as a holdover director until the earliest of: (a)&#160;90 days after the date on which the election inspector determines the voting results as to that director; (b)&#160;the date on which the Board of Directors appoints an individual to fill the office held by that director; or (c)&#160;the date of that director&#8217;s resignation. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">The Board of Directors may fill any vacancy resulting from the <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-election</span> of a director, or fill the office held by a holdover director, as provided in our Bylaws. The Governance and Nominating Committee will consider promptly whether to fill the office of a nominee who fails to receive a majority vote and make a recommendation to our Board about filling the office. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">The Board of Directors will act on the Governance and Nominating Committee&#8217;s recommendation and within 90 days after certification of the shareholder vote will disclose publicly its decision. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">Additional details about this process are specified in our Bylaws, which are available on our website at </p> <p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial"><span style="text-decoration:underline">aka.ms/policiesandguidelines</span>. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p><div style="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0075c9">&#160;</div> <p style="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:Arial" id="toc61756_49"><span style="color:#0075c9"><span style="font-weight:bold">Voting </span></span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold" id="toc61756_50">Shareholders Entitled to Vote; Quorum </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">Shareholders of record at the close of business on September&#160;30, 2026, will be entitled to vote during the Annual Meeting on the basis of one vote for each share held. Shareholders as of the record date are encouraged to vote prior to the meeting (1)&#160;via the Internet, (2)&#160;by phone, or (3)&#160;if you received your proxy materials by mail, by signing, dating, and returning the enclosed proxy card or voting instruction form. On September&#160;30, 2026, there were 7,426,426,719 shares of common stock outstanding, held of record by 73,581 shareholders. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">A majority of the outstanding shares of Microsoft common stock is required to constitute a quorum for the transaction of business at the Annual Meeting. The shares of a shareholder whose ballot on any or all proposals is marked as &#8220;abstain&#8221; or, in the case of an uncontested election of directors, &#8220;withheld,&#8221; will be included in the number of shares present during the Annual Meeting to determine whether a quorum is present. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold" id="toc61756_51">Vote Required; Effect of Abstentions and Broker <span style="white-space:nowrap">Non-Votes</span> </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">For each nominee and proposal submitted to the shareholders for a vote, approval requires a vote of the majority of the votes cast. A majority of votes cast means the number of shares cast &#8220;for&#8221; a nominee or proposal exceeds the number of shares cast &#8220;against&#8221; that nominee or proposal. Abstentions will not be counted as votes cast. Uninstructed shares will not be counted as votes cast except with respect to the ratification of the selection of our independent auditor, for which brokers and custodians have discretion to vote. A ballot for a nominee that is marked &#8220;withheld&#8221; will also not be counted as a vote cast. </p>

</table> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold" id="toc61756_52">Vote Confidentiality </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">We maintain the confidentiality of the votes of individual shareholders. Ballots, proxy forms, and voting instructions returned to&#160;brokerage firms, banks, and other holders of record are kept confidential. Only the proxy solicitor, proxy tabulator, and inspector of election have access to the ballots, proxy forms, and voting instructions. The proxy solicitor and the proxy tabulator will disclose information taken from the ballots, proxy forms, and voting instructions only if there is a proxy contest, if the shareholder authorizes disclosure, to defend legal claims, or as otherwise required by law. If you write comments on your proxy card or ballot, management may learn how you voted in reviewing your comments. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold" id="toc61756_53">Tabulation of Votes </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:Arial">Our independent election inspector, Broadridge Financial Services, will tabulate votes cast by proxy or electronically during the meeting. We expect to publish the final vote tabulation on our website at <span style="text-decoration:underline">microsoft.com/investor/corporate-governance/votingresults</span> and report the results in a Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) within four business days after the Annual Meeting. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold" id="toc61756_54">Where to Find More Proxy Voting Information </p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
